description: This file contains data models and database interaction functions for managing Tic-Tac-Toe game records, including creating games, adding moves, finalizing games, and retrieving game data.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] create_game(game_id: str)
methods.description: Creates a new game record with a unique ID and timestamp.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] add_move(game_id: str, move_number: int, player: str, position: int)
methods.description: Adds a move to an existing game with move details.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] finalize_game(game_id: str, result: Optional[str], final_board: str)
methods.description: Sets the final state of a game, including result and final board.

methods.name: Optional[Dict[str,Any]] get_game(game_id: str)
methods.description: Retrieves a game along with its move history.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] list_games(limit: int = 50, offset: int = 0)
methods.description: Lists recent games, limited by count and offset.

ctags.name: add_move
ctags.pattern: /^def add_move(game_id: str, move_number: int, player: str, position: int) -> Dict[str, Any]:$/
ctags.signature: (game_id: str, move_number: int, player: str, position: int)

ctags.name: finalize_game
ctags.pattern: /^def finalize_game(game_id: str, result: Optional[str], final_board: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:$/

ctags.name: list_games
ctags.pattern: /^def list_games(limit: int = 50, offset: int = 0) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:$/
